description: Key-rotation continuity sequences (SPEC-v2 §5.5 AcceptRotation). Initial state: sequence 0, 48 zero head bytes, current key = genesis_key, used key IDs = {genesis_key}, not frozen. After every step the harness asserts sequence, current key, recovery epoch, and frozen flag.

operations.accept: AcceptRotation(statement, state, now): appended advances the head; replay is an accepted body digest at its sequence (new signature bytes over that body are the same statement); rotation_fork freezes the authority and the frozen state is persisted; any other error leaves state unchanged
operations.recover: root-authorized recovery from the caller's control plane: increment recovery_epoch, anchor a new genesis to an unused key, retain the full used-key history, clear frozen

scenarios.name: continuity_fork_and_recovery
scenarios.description: genesis, idempotent repeats, continuation, fork freeze, rejected recoveries, root-authorized recovery with an epoch increase
